import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from aos7_evgap import summarize

class TestEvgap(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_gaps_and_bad(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            p = Path(tmp)
            (p/'obs.active.jsonl').write_text('{"seq":1}\n{"seq":4}\n{"seq":4}\n{"seq":true}\n{"seq":9}')
            out = summarize(p)
            self.assertEqual(out['channels']['obs']['missing'], [[2,3]])
            self.assertEqual(out['channels']['obs']['dup'], [4])
            self.assertEqual(out['channels']['obs']['count'], 3)
            self.assertEqual([x['why'] for x in out['bad']], ['no_seq','torn'])
            self.assertIsNone(out['channels']['obs']['next_seq'])
    def test_state_and_cli(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            p = Path(tmp)
            (p/'state.json').write_text('{"channels":{"obs":{"next_seq":true},"must":{"next_seq":2,"acked_upto":0}}}')
            (p/'must.active.jsonl').write_text('{"seq":1}\n')
            out = summarize(p)
            self.assertIsNone(out['channels']['obs']['next_seq'])
            self.assertEqual(out['channels']['must']['unacked'], 1)
            self.assertEqual(out['bad'][0]['why'], 'bad_state')
            entry=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'bin/aos7-evgap'
            result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(entry),tmp+'/absent'],capture_output=True)
            self.assertEqual((result.returncode,result.stdout),(2,b''))
